user.title: BRU Maker One
user.description: Choose a machine that is advertising. The first connection needs pairing mode: Machine Setup, Pair New Device, until the display says Waiting for connection.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Add {name}? Pairing does not happen now. On the first Start brew the machine must show Waiting for connection, then confirm the code.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a BRU machine.
abort.no_devices_found: No BRU machine is advertising. Turn Bluetooth on and, for a first bond, enable pairing mode.
abort.already_configured: This machine is already set up.

init.title: Custom teas
init.description: One tea per line: name; °C; steep time[; ml]. Steep time as 180, 3:00, or 3m30s. Water is optional, leave it out to keep the cup size. Lines starting with # are ignored.{error}

brew.name: Brew
brew.description: Start a brew, optionally with a tea and individual settings. The settings are kept for the next brew.

tea.name: Tea
tea.description: Built-in key (green, sencha, white, oolong, darjeeling, black, rooibos, herbal, fruit) or a custom tea name.
